title: Live Music Night @ Misty's Lounge
event_description: Nightly live music and DJ events featuring R&B vibes on Friday and line dance classes on Thursday evenings. All ages welcome.
event_venue_information:
Misty's Lounge

Located at the DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Ontario Airport Misty's Lounge is THE PREMIER night club in the entertainment capital of the Inland Empire. The venue features live music DJs and vibrant events weekly. Known for hosting international cover bands including Liquid Blue the official world record holder for The World's Most Traveled Band. The atmosphere caters to sophisticated adults seeking quality live entertainment with full service bar and food service. Special events include themed music nights and dancing.

Weekly Events

Thursday evenings feature Line Dance Classes and entertainment. Friday nights highlight R&B vibes with live DJ. Saturday evenings showcase live band performances and DJ entertainment.

title: Saturday Live Band Night @ Misty's Lounge
event_description: Weekend live band performances featuring talented musicians and DJs creating a vibrant dance and music atmosphere.
backline: Live Band and DJ Sound System
event_venue_information:
Misty's Lounge Entertainment

Misty's Lounge at the DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Ontario Airport stands as a premier nightlife destination featuring world-class entertainment. The venue hosts rotating live bands and professional DJs creating an upscale atmosphere for music lovers and dancers. Dress code enforced. Two beverage minimum required. Must be 21 years or older to enter.

Entertainment Focus

The venue specializes in cover bands spanning multiple genres from classic rock to R&B. The established sound system and professional staff ensure high-quality performances. Soto Entertainment Group manages professional entertainment including artist placement and band booking services.

title: Karaoke Tuesday & Taco Night @ Raquel's Jazz Lounge
event_description: Tuesday evening Karaoke and Taco special with hookah on patio. Casual music and social atmosphere for all skill levels.
event_venue_information:
Raquel's Jazz Lounge

Sophisticated lounge featuring live jazz and R&B music in an upscale setting. Located in nearby Rialto Raquel's Jazz Lounge offers a mature atmosphere with cigar patio cocktails and specialty foods. The venue hosts live band performances Friday and Saturday nights with R&B vibes on Friday and live jazz bands on Saturday. Line dance classes are held Thursdays. Special events include hookah and tacos on Tuesday evenings.

Music Genres

Raquel's specializes in Blues Jazz R&B and Funk music. The intimate setting with covered patio creates sophisticated ambiance ideal for music appreciation and socializing. Entry fees apply and reservations recommended for Friday and Saturday shows.

title: Thursday Jazz and Line Dancing @ Raquel's Jazz Lounge
event_description: Thursday evening line dance classes followed by live jazz and lounge atmosphere. Learn new steps and enjoy social dancing.
event_venue_information:
Raquel's Jazz Lounge Thursday Events

Every Thursday features Line Dance Class at Raquel's Jazz Lounge offering instruction for all skill levels. The welcoming atmosphere makes it perfect for learning new dance steps and building community connections. Following the class the venue transitions to social dancing and live entertainment with full bar service and appetizers available.

title: Friday R&B Night @ Raquel's Jazz Lounge
event_description: Friday evening R&B performance night with live DJ featuring smooth grooves and modern soul. Casual upscale dress recommended.
event_venue_information:
Friday R&B Nights at Raquel's

Experience the smooth sounds of R&B every Friday night at Raquel's Jazz Lounge. Live DJ entertainment sets the vibe with modern and classic R&B selections. The sophisticated atmosphere with covered patio and full service bar creates an ideal setting for enjoying quality music and cocktails with friends.

title: Saturday Live Jazz Band @ Raquel's Jazz Lounge
event_description: Saturday evening live jazz band performance in an upscale lounge setting. Reservations recommended for guaranteed seating.
backline: Live Jazz Band and Sound System
event_venue_information:
Saturday Jazz Performances at Raquel's

Live jazz bands perform every Saturday night at Raquel's Jazz Lounge creating an elegant atmosphere perfect for dinner dates and special occasions. Professional musicians deliver classic and contemporary jazz standards. The intimate venue with its sophisticated decor and attentive service makes this an ideal destination for jazz enthusiasts. Make reservations to guarantee seating as shows frequently fill to capacity.
